decisions.reason: It stayed prominently marketed on its own page across 2023 and 2024, is close to the firm’s core offer, and in an expanding firm with R&D slack this suggests performance at or above aspiration.

Its move from a website mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates improving internal evaluation versus aspiration, and its fit with the established airport software stack makes continued support likely.

Although somewhat less central than operational control products, it progressed from a mention to a dedicated page and the firm’s growth and broad software push give enough slack to retain it while results remain acceptable.

The product became more prominently marketed by 2024 and is strongly aligned with the firm’s apron operations and monitoring capabilities, so behavioral-theory logic points to retention rather than renewed problemistic search.
